To count LLM and embedding tokens, the current LlamaIndex docs use the `TokenCountingHandler` callback. The older built-in counting is deprecated. Per the migration guide, "The existing token counting implementation has been **deprecated**." [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/observability/callbacks/token_counting_migration.md]

The usage pattern docs describe the setup in three steps:

1. Create mock models so that no real API calls are made: "In order to measure LLM and Embedding token counts, you'll need to" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/evaluating/cost_analysis/usage_pattern.md], using `MockLLM` and `MockEmbedding`.
2. Create a `TokenCountingHandler` with a tokenizer and attach it to a callback manager: "callback_manager = CallbackManager([token_counter])" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/evaluating/cost_analysis/usage_pattern.md]
3. Set the mocks and callback manager on the global `Settings`, starting with "Settings.llm = llm" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/evaluating/cost_analysis/usage_pattern.md]. The excerpt cuts off before the rest of this step, so I can't quote the full line.

The docs say that "Tokens are counted using the `TokenCountingHandler` callback" and point to an example notebook for details [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/evaluating/cost_analysis/index.md]. This approach lets you estimate costs before any LLM calls are made: "This allows you to estimate your costs during 1) index construction, and 2) index querying, before any respective LLM calls are made." [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/evaluating/cost_analysis/index.md]

On the tokenizer, the docs say "By default, LlamaIndex uses a global tokenizer for all token counting. This defaults to `cl100k` from tiktoken" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/models/llms.md]. If you switch models, "you may need to update this tokenizer to ensure accurate token counts" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/models/llms.md].

I don't know how to read the final counts from the handler. The excerpts I have don't show its attribute or method names. The example notebook linked from the cost analysis docs should show that.
